widgets_values: A stunning portrait of a young East Asian woman with delicate features, fair porcelain skin, and long dark hair styled in an intricate updo adorned with golden ornaments and light blue floral accessories. She has large expressive brown eyes, soft pink lips, and wears dangling earrings with light blue teardrop gems. Her expression is serene and gentle as she looks directly at the camera. She is dressed in an elegant fantasy-inspired traditional Chinese hanfu featuring a high mandarin collar made of semi-transparent white fabric, a fitted bodice with subtle embroidery, and wide flowing sleeves that drape off her shoulders secured by golden wing-shaped clasps. The lower part of the dress transitions into a deep teal color with elaborate gold leaf embroidery and large stylized flower patterns around the waist. The background is a softly blurred forest scene with green foliage and dappled sunlight filtering through trees creating a dreamy bokeh effect. The lighting is natural and soft, highlighting the texture of the silk-like clothing and the smoothness of her skin. The composition is a medium shot focusing on her upper body, capturing the fine details of the costume and jewelry with razor-sharp focus and high definition clarity.

widgets_values: A full-body 3D character render of a cheerful young East Asian schoolgirl standing in a relaxed pose against a seamless pure white background. The girl has fair skin with soft rosy blush on her cheeks and wears a high ponytail hairstyle with dark brown hair, straight bangs framing her forehead, and a small orange hair tie securing the thick ponytail that sways to her left side. Her facial features include large expressive brown eyes with distinct white specular highlights, thin dark eyebrows arched slightly upwards, and a wide open-mouthed smile revealing a hint of teeth, conveying happiness and energy. She is dressed in an athletic school uniform consisting of a bright orange short-sleeved polo shirt with a white collar featuring orange trim, two small white buttons at the placket, and a shield-shaped crest logo on the left chest area with gold and white details. A vertical white stripe runs down the side of the shirt torso. She wears a matching pleated orange mini-skirt with two parallel white stripes running vertically down the sides of each leg panel. On her feet are white ankle socks and classic low-top sneakers that are primarily white with orange accents on the heel and side panels, paired with light brown gum soles and white laces. Her arms hang naturally by her sides with hands loosely clenched into soft fists, and her legs are planted firmly apart in a stable stance. The lighting is bright, diffuse studio lighting from the front-left, casting soft subtle shadows underneath her chin and skirt folds to enhance volume without harsh contrast. The texture is smooth and rendered in a high-quality Pixar-style 3D animation aesthetic with subsurface scattering on the skin for a realistic yet stylized look. The composition is centered with the subject occupying the majority of the frame, utilizing a neutral eye-level camera angle to capture the full figure from head to toe with razor-sharp focus and clean edges.
